name: Memory Enhancements
description: Memory-core companions. Live: the O(1) anchor → chunk hippocampus index, and the memory write gate (config key contradictionGate): one gate in front of every memory note write, from Claude Code workers and from the gateway's embedded runner. It reads the notes in the same folder and the always-loaded rule files and gives each write one outcome: saved with its source, skipped as a repeat, saved with the old line struck and dated, refused until the owner answers a clash, or kept as a quote only. Ships in watch mode (logs what it would do). Still a scaffold: task-conditioned retrieval scoring. Observer only: compaction-aware capture.

indexDir.description: Where the pre-computed anchor → chunk concept index is stored.

minConceptLength.description: Minimum concept token length to be indexed (shorter tokens are noise).

importanceThreshold.description: Minimum importance score [0,1] for a concept to survive pruning.

taskWeight.description: How strongly current task context biases retrieval scores [0,1].

contradictionGate.description: The memory write gate. On gateway start the plugin publishes the resolved config to <state dir>/memory-gate/config.json for the tinkerclaw-core Claude Code hook, and guards the embedded runner's write/edit tools itself. Every decision is a row in <state dir>/data/memory-gate/gate.jsonl.

enabled.description: false: no gate at all (the published config is removed).

mode.description: warn: watch mode, every write goes through unchanged and the gate only logs what it would have done. block: enforce, a repeat is skipped, a clash or an unsourced rule is refused until the owner answers, an update keeps the old line struck and dated, someone else's words are saved as a quote only.

roots.description: Folders or single files whose Markdown notes the gate guards. Default: the Claude Code auto-memory folder (autoMemoryDirectory in ~/.claude/settings.json) and, per agent workspace, MEMORY.md and memory/. Claude Code's per-project memory folders are always included.

rulesFiles.description: Always-loaded files a new line is checked against for a clash. Default: per agent workspace AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, USER.md, IDENTITY.md, MEMORY.md, plus the auto-memory folder's MEMORY.md.

excludeDirs.description: Folder names under a root that hold logs, not notes; writes there pass untouched.

compactionCapture.description: v0.1 OBSERVER-ONLY: logs which messages would be dropped on compaction. Does NOT delay compaction and does NOT persist anything yet — those land in v0.2.

captureMode.description: dropped-only: log only messages about to be lost. full-context: log entire context window. v0.1 is log-only either way.
